scene: The cavern rumbles, unveiling hidden platforms and three waiting transit cars.
picture: A flat side view along a wide stone walkway above mossy water. On the far left waits a glowing yellow night tram. Near centre stands the curly-haired boy with his camera, beside an open mesh service elevator. To the right sits the now-unfurled lily pad, and on the far right waits an open freight lift.
shown: a luminous yellow night tram idling at a platform on the far left
an open metal service elevator cage with flashing roof lights in the centre
a heavy iron freight lift with an open gate on the far right
